formula_samples:
=SUMIFS('SELLING CASH'!$I:$I,
  'SELLING CASH'!$C:$C, ">=" & DATE($B$4, 1, 1),
  'SELLING CASH'!$C:$C, "<=" & DATE($B$4, 12, 31),
  'SELLING CASH'!$R:$R, "<>OIL")
+
SUMIFS('SELLING CREDIT'!$P:$P,
  'SELLING CREDIT'!$C:$C, ">=" & DATE($B$4, 1, 1),
  'SELLING CREDIT'!$C:$C, "<=" & DATE($B$4, 12, 31),
  'SELLING CREDIT'!$S:$S, "<>OIL")

=SUMIFS('SELLING CASH'!$F:$F,
  'SELLING CASH'!$C:$C, ">=" & DATE($B$4, 1, 1),
  'SELLING CASH'!$C:$C, "<=" & DATE($B$4, 12, 31),
  'SELLING CASH'!$R:$R, "TIRE")
+
SUMIFS('SELLING CREDIT'!$G:$G,
  'SELLING CREDIT'!$C:$C, ">=" & DATE($B$4, 1, 1),
  'SELLING CREDIT'!$C:$C, "<=" & DATE($B$4, 12, 31),
  'SELLING CREDIT'!$S:$S, "TIRE")

=SUMIFS('SELLING CASH'!$N:$N,
  'SELLING CASH'!$C:$C, ">=" & DATE($B$4, 1, 1),
  'SELLING CASH'!$C:$C, "<=" & DATE($B$4, 12, 31),
  'SELLING CASH'!$R:$R, "<>OIL", 'SELLING CASH'!$R:$R, "<>SERVICE")
+
SUMIFS('PAYMENT CREDIT'!$G:$G,
  'PAYMENT CREDIT'!$C:$C, ">=" & DATE($B$4, 1, 1),
  'PAYMENT CREDIT'!$C:$C, "<=" & DATE($B$4, 12, 31))

=SUMIFS('SELLING CASH'!N:N, 'SELLING CASH'!C:C, E5, 'SELLING CASH'!R:R, "<>SERVICE", 'SELLING CASH'!R:R, "<>OIL") + 
SUMIF('PAYMENT CREDIT'!C:C, E5, 'PAYMENT CREDIT'!G:G)-
E10-E14-SUMIF('SELLING CREDIT'!C:C,E5,'SELLING CREDIT'!K:K)

=if(M2="Cash","LUNAS",
   IF(M2="Tempo 14 Days",D2+14,
    if(M2="Tempo 30 Days",D2+30,
     IF(M2="Tempo 2 Month",D2+60,if(M2="Tempo DUNLOP",D2+75,0)))))

if(M3="Tempo 30 Days",D3+30,

=IF(COUNTIFS('PAYMENT CREDIT'!D:D, W8, 'PAYMENT CREDIT'!E:E, W10) > 0, 
    0, 
    SUMIFS('SELLING CREDIT'!Q:Q, 'SELLING CREDIT'!C:C, W8, 'SELLING CREDIT'!E:E, W10) +
    SUMIFS('SELLING CREDIT'!K:K, 'SELLING CREDIT'!C:C, W8, 'SELLING CREDIT'!E:E, W10)
)

=IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("QUERY({
    FILTER({'SELLING CASH'!E:F, TRIM('SELLING CASH'!R:R)}, 
      YEAR('SELLING CASH'!C:C) = VALUE(DASHBOARD!B4),
      TRIM('SELLING CASH'!R:R) = ""Tire"");
    
    FILTER({'SELLING CREDIT'!F:G, TRIM('SELLING CREDIT'!S:S)}, 
      YEAR('SELLING "&"CREDIT'!C:C) = VALUE(DASHBOARD!B4),
      TRIM('SELLING CREDIT'!S:S) = ""Tire"")
  },
  ""SELECT Col1, SUM(Col2) 
   WHERE Col1 IS NOT NULL 
   GROUP BY Col1 
   ORDER BY SUM(Col2) DESC 
   LIMIT 15"")"),"")
